name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on acquiring and creating gold royalties and exploration streams, primarily within the state of Nevada. The company operates through a three-pronged model of mineral royalty creation, precious metals streaming and financing, and exploration project acceleration. It is not a direct mine operator but rather aggregates royalty interests on smaller producing and pre-production gold properties in one of the world's top-rated mining jurisdictions.
